definitions.ask: Should Muse's large tier default move from muse-spark-1.3 to muse-wonder-1.0?

choices.label: Unpinned Muse launches run Wonder, Muse Code's default; API tokens cost ~3-5x Spark's
Both tiers stay on muse-spark-1.3; Wonder runs only when named or picked by alias

definitions.why: Wonder is on every Muse Code plan and the API; SASE large tiers follow each flagship

definitions.ask: Should the shipped @large size alias also load-balance onto Muse Wonder?

choices.label: All size-alias pools stay as they are; @large never picks Wonder on its own
Add muse/muse-wonder-1.0@xhigh to @large; about 1/4 of @large launches run Wonder
Add muse/muse-wonder-1.0-contributor@xhigh to @large; cheaper, but Meta trains on it

definitions.why: Wonder is a days-old preview with self-reported benchmarks; try it by name first
